descriptionByLocale.it:
Situato a Château-d-Oex, a 1000 metri sul livello del mare, il Country-d-Enhaut Health Centre offre una vasta gamma di servizi ospedalieri, alloggi, accompagnamento per gli anziani e la cura della casa. Secondo il cosiddetto approccio integrato alla cura, questa organizzazione innovativa rappresenta un'opportunità per i professionisti della salute di lavorare in piccoli team multidisciplinari, per una migliore continuità di cura e in risposta alle esigenze sanitarie della popolazione del Paese superiore. Nel cuore di un ambiente naturale privilegiato, a meno di un'ora di distanza da Losanna o Berna, il Pays-d'Enhaut è rinomato per la sua qualità di vita e offre una vasta gamma di attività sportive, ricreative e culturali, per vivere l'estate e l'inverno! Per il suo settore EMS Accommodation , il Dipartimento della Salute del Paese sta cercando un: Tasso di attività 80% La vostra missione:
• Accompagnamento dei residenti nell'esecuzione delle attività quotidiane
• Effettuare atti medicotecnici in situazioni comuni
• Mantenere la cura del residente, mobili e ambiente
• Collabora con il team multidisciplinare per comunicare le informazioni inerenti alla cura del residente Il tuo profilo:
• Titolare di un CFC di ASSC
• Interessi nella cura degli anziani
• Interessi nel lavoro di squadra e nel senso della comunicazione
• Buona organizzazione e leadership
• Accesso agli strumenti IT Offriamo:
• Partecipazione allo sviluppo di un modello di assistenza integrata, che coinvolge il coordinamento e la collaborazione di diversi operatori sanitari
• Lavoro in un ambiente piacevole, all'interno di una struttura di dimensioni umane
• I vantaggi di vivere in montagna rimanendo vicino ai centri urbani (da scoprire sotto www.alpesvaudoises.ch/en/stories/ paysdenhaut)
• Condizioni di lavoro secondo il CLC san-vaud (13 ° stipendio, formazione, 5-6 settimane di vacanza all'anno, ecc...) Inviaci il tuo file completo (CV, lettera di copertura, diplomi, riconoscimento Croce Rossa svizzera se necessario e certificati di lavoro) a Jobup
descriptionByLocale.en:
Located in Château-d-Oex, at 1000 meters above sea level, the Country-d-Enhaut Health Centre offers a wide range of hospital services, accommodation, accompaniment for the elderly and home care. According to the so-called integrated care approach, this innovative organization represents an opportunity for health professionals to work in small multidisciplinary teams, for better continuity of care and in response to the health needs of the population of the Upper Country. In the heart of a privileged natural environment, less than an hour away from Lausanne or Bern, the Pays-d'Enhaut is renowned for its quality of life and offers a very wide range of sports, leisure and cultural activities, to live summer and winter! For its EMS Accommodation Sector , the Country Health Department is looking for a: Community Health and Care Assistant (CHS) Activity rate 80% Your mission:
• Accompanying residents in the performance of daily activities
• Performing medicotechnical acts in common situations
• Maintaining the resident's care, furniture and environment
• Collaborate with the multidisciplinary team to communicate the information inherent in the care of the resident Your profile:
• Holder of an CFC of ASSC
• Interest in caring for the elderly
• Interest in teamwork and sense of communication
• Good organization and leadership
• Access with IT tools We offer:
• Participation in the development of an integrated care model, involving the coordination and collaboration of different health professionals
• Work in a pleasant environment, within a human-sized structure
• The benefits of living in the mountains while remaining close to urban centres (to be discovered under www.alpesvaudoises.ch/en/stories/ paysdenhaut)
• Working conditions in accordance with the CLC san-vaud (13th salary, training, 5-6 weeks of vacation per year, etc...) Please send us your complete file (CV, cover letter, diplomas, Swiss Red Cross recognition if necessary and work certificates) to Jobup
descriptionByLocale.de:
Das Hotel liegt in Château-d-Oex, auf 1000 Meter über dem Meeresspiegel, bietet das Country-d-Enhaut Gesundheitszentrum eine breite Palette von Krankenhausdienstleistungen, Unterkunft, Begleitung für ältere Menschen und häusliche Pflege. Gemäß dem sogenannten integrierten Versorgungsansatz stellt diese innovative Organisation eine Möglichkeit für Angehörige der Gesundheitsberufe dar, in kleinen multidisziplinären Teams zu arbeiten, um die Kontinuität der Versorgung zu verbessern und auf die gesundheitlichen Bedürfnisse der Bevölkerung des Oberlandes zu reagieren. Inmitten einer privilegierten natürlichen Umgebung, weniger als eine Stunde von Lausanne oder Bern entfernt, ist das Pays-d'Enhaut für seine Lebensqualität bekannt und bietet ein sehr breites Spektrum an Sport-, Freizeit- und kulturellen Aktivitäten, um Sommer und Winter zu leben! Für seinen EMS-Unterkunftssektor sucht das Gesundheitsministerium des Landes nach: Community Health and Care Assistant (CHS) Aktivitätsrate 80% Ihre Mission:
• Begleitung der Bewohner bei der Durchführung der täglichen Aktivitäten
• Durchführung medizintechnische Handlungen in gemeinsamen Situationen
• Pflege, Möbel und Umwelt des Bewohners
• Arbeiten Sie mit dem multidisziplinären Team zusammen, um die Informationen zu kommunizieren, die der Pflege des Bewohners innewohnen Ihr Profil:
• Inhaber einer CFC von ASSC
• Interesse an der Pflege älterer Menschen
• Interesse an Teamwork und Kommunikationssinn
• Gute Organisation und Führung
• Zugang mit IT-Tools Wir bieten:
• Beteiligung an der Entwicklung eines integrierten Versorgungsmodells, das die Koordination und Zusammenarbeit verschiedener Gesundheitsexperten umfasst
• Arbeiten in einer angenehmen Umgebung, innerhalb einer menschlichen Struktur
• Die Vorteile, in den Bergen zu leben und dabei in der Nähe von Stadtzentren zu bleiben (zu entdecken unter www.alpesvaudoises.ch/de/stories/paysdenhaut)
• Arbeitsbedingungen gemäß CLC san-vaud (13. Gehalt, Ausbildung, 5-6 Wochen Urlaub pro Jahr, etc...) Bitte senden Sie uns Ihre vollständige Datei (Lebenslauf, Anschreiben, Diplome, ggf. Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz und Arbeitsbescheinigungen) an Jobup
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Situé à Château-d’Œx, à 1000 mètres d’altitude, le Pôle Santé Pays-d’Enhaut offre un large éventail de prestations hospitalières, d’hébergement, d’accompagnement de la personne âgée, ainsi que des soins à domicile. Selon l’approche dite de soins intégrés, cette organisation novatrice représente une opportunité pour les professionnel·le·s de la santé de travailler au sein de petites équipes multidisciplinaires, pour une meilleure continuité des soins et en réponse aux besoins de santé de la population du Pays-d’Enhaut.
Au cœur d’un environnement naturel privilégié, à moins d’une heure de Lausanne ou de Berne, le Pays-d’Enhaut est réputé pour la qualité de son cadre de vie et offre un très large éventail d’activités sportives, de loisirs et culturelles, à vivre été comme hiver!
Pour son Secteur Hébergement EMS , le Pôle Santé du Pays-d’Enhaut recherche un·e :

Assistant·e en soins et santé communautaire (ASSC) Taux d’activité 80 %

Votre mission :

• Accompagner les résidents dans l’accomplissement des activités de la vie quotidienne

• Accomplir des actes médicotechniques dans des situations courantes

• Entretenir le matériel de soins, du mobilier et de l’environnement du résident

• Collaborer avec l’équipe pluridisciplinaire afin de transmettre les informations inhérentes à la prise en charge du résident
Votre profil :

• Titulaire d’un CFC d’ASSC

• Intérêt pour les soins à la personne âgée

• Intérêt pour le travail d’équipe et sens de la communication

• Bonne organisation et leadership

• Aisance avec les outils informatiques
Nous offrons :

• Une participation au développement d’un modèle de soins intégrés, impliquant la coordination et la collaboration de différents professionnels de la santé

• Un travail dans un environnement agréable, au sein d’une structure à taille humaine

• Les avantages de la vie en montagne tout en restant proches de centres urbains (à découvrir sous www.alpesvaudoises.ch/fr/stories/paysdenhaut)

• Des conditions de travail conformes à la CCT san-vaud (13e salaire, formations, 5-6 semaines de vacances par année, etc...)
 *
Merci de nous faire parvenir votre dossier complet (CV, lettre de motivation, diplômes, reconnaissances Croix-Rouge suisse si nécessaire et certificats de travail) sur Jobup

According to the so-called integrated care approach, this innovative organization presents an opportunity for healthcare professionals to work within small multidisciplinary teams, ensuring better continuity of care and responding to the health needs of the Pays-d’Enhaut population. In the heart of a privileged natural environment, less than an hour from Lausanne or Bern, Pays-d’Enhaut is renowned for the quality of its living environment and offers a very broad range of sports, leisure, and cultural activities, to be enjoyed both in summer and winter! For its Home Care Sector, the Pays-d’Enhaut Health Center is looking for: Position Situation Lead Nurse and/or Mental Health Nurse (80–100%) Start Date - September 1 or to be agreed - Generally attached to the home care sector, you may also be tasked with occasional missions within the accommodation and hospital sectors. Your Mission - Assess home care situations and serve as a leadership reference point - Provide medico-technical nursing care and actively contribute to team dynamics - Ensure appropriate care for people of all ages, in collaboration with their support network - Participate, in a multidisciplinary manner, in organizing and monitoring the care plan defined with the client Your
• Profile - Bachelor HES-SO in nursing or a diploma recognized by the Swiss Red Cross - 2 years of experience in the psychiatric field - Listening skills, autonomy, and ability to manage complex situations - Proactivity and ease in networking - Proficiency with standard computer tools - Valid driver’s license and vehicle essential - Knowledge of home care: an advantage What We Offer - Participation in developing an integrated care model involving coordination and collaboration among various healthcare professionals - Work in a pleasant environment within a small-sized structure - The benefits of mountain life while remaining close to urban centers (discover more at www.alpesvaudoises.ch/fr/stories/paysdenhaut) - Working conditions compliant with the CCT san-vaud (13th salary, training, 5-6 weeks of vacation per year, etc...) Contact Please send your complete application (CV, cover letter, diplomas, and work certificates) via Jobup.
